coverage.headline: Idaho Holds Off UC Davis 31-28 in Final Seconds
coverage.recap:
Idaho defeated UC Davis 31-28 on Saturday at the Kibbie Dome, escaping with a narrow victory on a late fourth-quarter touchdown pass with 48 seconds remaining.

The Vandals opened the scoring on a 42-yard touchdown pass in the first quarter to take an early 7-0 advantage. UC Davis answered midway through the second quarter, tying the game at 7 on an 8-yard rushing touchdown. Idaho reclaimed the lead heading into the fourth quarter with a 38-yard field goal, but the Aggies struck again at the 2:15 mark on a 24-yard scoring pass to move ahead 14-10.

Idaho answered with a game-winning drive capped by an 18-yard touchdown throw with 48 seconds left. UC Davis threatened on the ensuing possession but could not overcome the deficit, leaving Idaho with a 31-28 final.

The Vandals won the turnover battle decisively, forcing three UC Davis miscues compared to just one of their own. UC Davis held a slight edge in total yardage — 399 to Idaho's 388 — and passed for 287 yards to Idaho's 243. The Vandals controlled the ground game, however, rushing for 145 yards to the Aggies' 112.

Idaho's offense converted on 22 first downs to UC Davis's 18, keeping drives alive throughout a contest that featured multiple lead changes. The Vandals made the necessary plays when it mattered most, turning the turnover margin into a decisive advantage that offset the Aggies' yardage edge and held up in the final seconds. Idaho improves its record with the hard-fought home victory.
coverage.spotlight_body: Doe completed 18 of 27 passes for 243 yards and two touchdowns to lead the Vandal offense. His 18-yard scoring throw with 48 seconds left proved to be the game-winner.
coverage.social_post: Idaho holds on 31-28! The Vandals turned three UC Davis turnovers into points, surviving a late comeback attempt to secure the win. #GoVandals
